plan.time_alignment: nearest nominal2s bin, one-to-one, actual timestamp retained; max deviation0.2s
plan.architecture: Independent3D U-Net perselectedtime widths8/16/32/64, stride2convdown/repeatupsampling,GroupNormSiLU,skipconcatenation,13inputs1logit; no timeinput
plan.conditioning: four static fuel-density maps,xyz coordinates; broadcast wind,moisture,loading,height,cos/sin ignitionangle. Fixed+Xwind/fixedignitionstrengthduration. No time or groundtruth fields.
plan.loss: per-time training-population class-balanced BCE; half positive mean plus half negative mean. If no training positives at a time, cold-only BCE. Weights frozen from TRAIN only; no auxiliary loss.
plan.evaluation: Everyepoch all360train and32valconfigs40trajectories at the model assignedtime. Average replicas withinconfiguration before counts aggregation; positive precision recall F1 IoU,FPR,hotfraction,balancedBCE plusmacroconfig metrics. Independent weights/optimizer pertime; identical initialization and batchordering.
plan.scope: Previously examined development configurations, not pristine test. Direct time-conditioned HOT snapshots, no state evolution/fuel consumption. Legacy40train8val omitted.
plan.stopping: ConstantLR3e-4. After50epochs compare consecutive10epochmean trainANDval balancedBCE (<1%relative or1e-4absolute) andpositive precision/recall/F1 (<.01absolute). Three consecutive10epochchecks required. Undefined metrics remain undefined. Max300orclouddeadline is not convergence.
